beliefs: f splits input on whitespace runs, reverses each word, and joins with single spaces [E2, E3, E4, E5]
If there is more than one word, 'lmKA' is inserted immediately before the last reversed word with a space before it [E2, E3, E4, E5]
If there is exactly one word and no surrounding whitespace, 'lmKA' is prepended to the reversed word [E1, E6]
If there is exactly one word with leading whitespace, 'lmKA' is prepended; with trailing whitespace, 'lmKA' is appended [E7]
Leading/trailing whitespace is stripped; whitespace-only or empty input yields just 'lmKA' [E1, E3, E4]
For a single word, lmKA goes before if there is leading whitespace (or none), after if there is only trailing whitespace [E7]
notes: E7 shows single-word lmKA placement depends on leading vs trailing whitespace: leading (or none) -> prepend, trailing-only -> append. Fixed predict() to check leading whitespace instead of any surrounding whitespace.
